g.title: cluster_agent
g.text: Storyteller Agent (gpt-3.5-turbo, tool calling, one conversation)

g.title: user
g.text: name · age 5-10 · genre (Surprise me, 11 genres, My own idea)

g.title: guard
g.text: clean text · real names only · injection check

g.title: screen
g.text: Safety screen (1 LLM call, only for "My own idea")

g.title: auto
g.text: plan → write → review → add/shorten to fit

g.title: checks
g.text: words 500-800 · safety words · repeats · copying the example
overused words · hard words · habits · passive · talking

g.title: judge
g.text: safety veto · yes/no checklist → score in code

g.title: rails
g.text: no writing before plan passes · text checked before accepted
finish refused unless safe, in range, no copy/repeat, reviewed, passing
args validated · repeats refused · budgets: 24 tools / 34 turns / 150 s
